messages:
nina (AE): Heads-up: Nordbridge (wealth mgmt) wants a 30-day POC. Requirements: data must stay in EU + Switzerland + Canada, no US subprocessors touching any inference payloads or logs during POC, BYO-KMS for CH+CA, and they need a short security Q&A answered by EOD. Can we commit?

omar (SE): Short answer: yes with constraints. We can pin serving to eu & ch regions and add canada. Switzerland is supported via eu-westX (we map to Zurich region on dedicated/private). Need legal confirmation on subprocessors and whether managed backups/archives can be scoped.

claire (Presales): Pricing: Recommend two quote paths: 1) Hosted pinned endpoints (no telemetry + egress rules) — fastest. 2) Small Dedicated (tenant pin + peering) — higher cost but stronger guarantees. BYO-KMS will be an add-on per-region. I'll draft both options.

legal-bot: Subprocessor inventory (internal): https://redwood.internal/subprocessors. Note: logs/analytics vendor has collectors in US and APAC. For strict POC we can disable analytics and provide an attestation. Backups default to EU but some metadata flows to US for billing; we can request ops to restrict.

nina (AE): They also sent a security Q: "Does any third-party SaaS handle raw inference text?" Need a clear yes/no + list.

omar (SE): Answer draft: "By default, inference requests are handled by Redwood's serving runtime in the pinned regions. Telemetry/analytics may sample traces; we will disable telemetry for the tenant during the POC. No third-party SaaS will process raw inference text if telemetry is disabled or if Private deployment is used." I'll tidy and add model residency note.

tomas (Infra): Operational notes: to block subprocessors we have two levers: 1) Tenant-level telemetry off (no external collectors) 2) Deploy in Dedicated or Private so control plane and backups are inside the customer's VPC/regions. For Hosted pinned endpoints we can enforce egress ACLs but some managed infra metadata may still be in provider control plane. Will need a short runbook to guarantee no accidental egress.

ops-bot: Recommended runbook steps:
1) Create tenant with routing.allowed_regions = ["eu-west3","ch-central1","northamerica-northeast1"]
2) Set telemetry.enabled = false for tenant
3) Enable subprocessor_blocklist = ["us-analytics-1","apac-collector-2"]
4) Configure BYO-KMS per-region and validate key access
5) Smoke test: send synthetic payloads, confirm no outbound flows to blocked regions (tcpdump + flow logs)

claire (Presales): I'll include a 30-day teardown clause in the quote. Also add a one-time setup fee for peering/KMS handoff. ETA for drafts: 2.5h.

nina (AE): Please include a one-pager attestation that we will not route inference payloads outside specified regions for the POC, and an itemized checklist of what we cannot guarantee if they choose hosted vs private.

omar (SE): Will do. Also adding model weight residency paragraph: "We keep model artifacts in region storage. During autoscale we do not transfer weights outside allowed_regions. Cache warming may replicate KV cache in-region only."

legal-bot: We'll prepare a signed attestation template. Also note: SOC2 report available on request; for CH+CA BYO-KMS we must capture key ARNs and rotate policy agreement.

nina (AE): Great — I'll ask Nordbridge for their BYO-KMS ARN for CH & CA and the security questionnaire PDF. If we get those today we can aim to start the POC next Mon. :crossed_fingers:
